c277fd563613cda6767258838574386d16e830eb.summary: The Swiss government CERT (GovCERT) analysed Fobber, a new e-banking Trojan that appears to be a spinoff of Tinba, to check whether Swiss critical infrastructure was targeted. Highlights include function-level encryption that keeps code encrypted until it is called, position-independent code, and hash-based import resolution. The report says the samples it examined seem to share one campaign key. It knows of no Swiss financial institutions targeted so far.
